title: Display input focus
goal: Use :focus to display an outline that moves with the focus in the class material filter box.
summary: When you move to the input box by clicking or Tab, the current control will gain focus. :focus matches the element that currently has focus.
tasks: Use input:focus to select the focused filter box and set the solid outline color to #125a46.
Use outline-offset to offset the outline 4px outward, and the unfocused filter box retains its original appearance.
hint: Try pressing Tab between two boxes. Always only the boxes currently available for input are outlined in green.

example.note: When moving between the submit button and the return button with the keyboard, the focus outline marks the button that can currently be triggered by pressing Enter.
